scope: Current non-preview GFL1, GFL2 and Blue Archive Onlystory catalog. PJSK and design fixtures excluded.
verdict: Not all available stories can be acquired by a new standalone user without an Onlystory asset backend. BA prologue only has implemented Windows acquisition, and manual browser import.

localInventory.method: Every current non-preview game story; chapter asset lists plus all scene-program file inventories; HTTP HEAD for every deduplicated declared file, rejecting HTML fallbacks. Source support uses the production hasOnlineSource predicate.

limits: Local HTTP HEAD checks establish declared-file access, not complete download/hash/decode/offline-playback verification.
Public-source probe scope and exact full-body versus header checks are specified in each per-game report.
Prepared local exports do not establish source acquisition on a new machine.
Existing provenance gaps not listed as files are separate from missing HTTP assets.
No app implementation changes or executable rebuilds were made.
